The checkweigher would then have printed passing labels for jars that don't hold 250 g of powder. I didn't do that, so the labels are an honest record. The weights are still on the shelf. J2 is still on the platform, partly filled.

**Next time:** I'd switch to fine and micro doses earlier, stop each jar a bit under the target instead of overshooting and scooping back, and keep an eye on the time per jar. Even so, three jars in 12 minutes is tight with this powder lot.
